raw:
@q query
  select ?h
  where all
    match
      relation "be a haulier"
      role subject ?h
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have a cost per pallet"
      role subject ?h
      role object ?price
      role time "Q2"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  rank lowest ?price

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "our three hauliers"
  role object "Dachser, Kuehne+Nagel, the local guys from Ploiesti"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation
